Original 2 mm cord radius retained as a display estimate. Front leads use the measured native bore outward axis; the solver derives their short exterior exit segment from the native solid support plane. No authored route stations.

authoringRule: Terminal stations are deliberately selected actual native mouth/bearing points. Routes and hanging height are generated, never authored by hand. Hidden connectivity is omitted unless retained evidence supports it. Measured cylindrical void lengths are separately retained in native-channel-measurements.json where applicable.
lengthPolicy: Penta retains the manufacturer 60 cm loop; other lengths/radii are carried display estimates and do not imply a manufacturer load or installation specification.
generatedCollarPolicy: Outward mouthAxis [0,0,1] is the native four-through-bore direction documented in native-channel-measurements.json. Native solid support bounds determine a short exit point; only measured mouths/axis are authored. Original 2 mm cord display radius retained. Up to five deterministic generated lead-margin attempts must pass unchanged continuous 3D and self/interstrand tube gates.

mouthAxisSourceMapping.interpretation: Front mouths lie on native Y=-25 mm; the analytic cylinders run through 50 mm to Y=+25 mm. Front visible leads exit toward negative native Y. The original source-backed four-through-bore graph and rear exterior returns are retained.
